verification_policy: Single-skill Strike Super research: independently reconcile Xenoverse 2 identity, race restriction, acquisition route, mechanics, and Ultimate Finish condition. Preserve unresolved probability and stamina fields as null.
research_scope: Burning Slash — Strike Super / Future Trunks acquisition and mechanics research.

verification_audit.method: Compared repository research coverage with current Xenoverse 2-specific documentation and independent acquisition references.

duplicate_check.identity_note: No existing repository research batch for Burning Slash was found. Canonical identity is Super / Strike.

verification_audit.classification_finding: Current Xenoverse 2 documentation classifies Burning Slash as a Strike Super and separately lists it among Human and Saiyan skills.
verification_audit.acquisition_finding: Current Xenoverse 2-specific documentation identifies Parallel Quest 44 — Dragon Balls of the Future as the acquisition route. Community evidence establishes the quest but does not conclusively establish that the skill is Ultimate-Finish-only.
verification_audit.finish_policy: ultimate_finish_required remains null because sources disagree or are insufficiently direct about whether the reward is tied specifically to the Ultimate Finish.
verification_audit.race_policy: Burning Slash is restricted to Human and Saiyan CaCs; this restriction is retained explicitly.
verification_audit.cost_policy: Ki cost is 100. Stamina cost remains null.

records.name: Burning Slash
records.character_source: Future Trunks / Trunks (Future) / Human & Saiyan CaCs / Tapion customizable partner
records.source_quest_or_shop: Parallel Quest 44 — Dragon Balls of the Future
records.skill_description: A serial sword attack that strikes repeatedly; if the sequence connects, an additional input fires a follow-up Ki Blast that launches the opponent away.
records.mechanics_notes: The documented move uses a sword for a five-hit slash sequence and allows a follow-up Ki Blast after the final slash. The canonical reference describes the skill as a weapon-based, short-range, five-to-nine-hit attack with a follow-up. Exact frame and damage values are not promoted beyond documented descriptive values.
records.acquisition_notes: PQ44 is the current Xenoverse 2 acquisition route. Community reports indicate RNG and disagree on whether the Ultimate Finish is mandatory; this batch therefore does not encode an unsupported mandatory-UF claim.
records.pve_notes: PQ44 farming is required; exact drop probability and UF-only status remain unresolved.
records.pvp_notes: Short-range sword Strike Super with a conditional Ki Blast follow-up. Detailed matchup and frame claims remain version-sensitive.
